notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Size - 2.1MB

We have just released a small update fixing a pair of achievements.

Bug Fixes
Galactic Overlord - Fixed an issue where the game was not tracking completed missions properly.
Academia Nut - Fixed an issue where level four skills were not being tracked properly.

Thanks to the achievement hunters who reported these issues!

notes.title: Patch Update
notes.notes:
New Fixes and Tweaks - 8 May 2015

Change Log
Fixed an issue where some players were unable to scroll around the map.
Removed legacy references to DirectPlay that may have been causing some issues on Windows 8.1.
The launcher now looks for Steam Workshop files in the Steam folder rather than transferring them to the Documents\Space Colony folder.
Added extra Steam Workshop functionality to enable creators to update their Workshop items.
Fixed Stair Climber entry in English help file.
Added log file output to help debug startup issues.
